answer.reason: The verses tell what was made of the shields and what became of them, which the summary does not say.

clauses.english: was made by Solomon of beaten gold and kept in the house of the forest of Lebanon
clauses.quote: the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon

clauses.english: was carried off by Shishak king of Egypt when he came against Jerusalem
clauses.quote: he took away all the shields of gold which Solomon had made

doubts: The summary names the shields and their place, so the first clause partly repeats it, though it adds that Solomon made them of beaten gold.
1KI 10:17 says three pound of gold per shield while 2CH 9:16 says three hundred shekels; neither figure is used.
